Axiom window chrome

One band instead of two. The menus, the document and the native caption buttons share a 36 pixel title bar. The panes move to a rail. The window reports itself in a 22 pixel status bar. Nothing about which commands exist, how they are grouped or what they are called has changed.

Every number below was read out of the attached screenshot of Axiom, row by row, in device pixels.

The two rows sit on one unbroken ground. Every row from 0 to 105 has the same modal colour, #f3f3f3, and the content ground #fafafa begins at row 106. They already look like one band, because they already are one band. 29 of those 106 rows, 27% of the chrome, is the blank gutter between two rows of text printed on the same colour.

The band is 2,867 device pixels wide. The last label ends at 703. 2,163 pixels, 75.4% of a full width band, carries nothing, and the eight labels themselves are 419 pixels of ink. This is the same defect the Ontology Quality settings region has, where a flexible spacer pushes the primary action 1,520 pixels across an empty row. Here it is not one row that is mostly empty. It is a whole band.

71 CSS px of chrome now, reading the capture at 150% scaling
36 CSS px proposed

The capture does not record its display scaling, and the evidence in it is split: a 16 pixel title icon drawn at 34 device pixels argues for 200%, while the text metrics argue for 150% with a 14 pixel font. So the 106 rows are either 71 or 53 CSS pixels. The new band is 36 under either reading, which is why the comparison is safe to make and the exact scale is not worth guessing at.

Where each thing went

ThingWasIs now
The eight menusA dedicated full width bandInline in the title band, each at its own width
The documentA static title stringA pill naming the file and its folder, which opens the command palette
Minimize, maximize, closeNative, far rightStill native, in a 138 pixel region the band reserves and never draws into
Reaching a paneThe View menu, 20 entries deepThe rail, one click, with View kept whole as the keyboard route
Save stateAn asterisk in the title stringThe asterisk, plus a status bar segment that says which state it is in

The rail is why the View menu can stay long

Axiom has at least fourteen panes with a View entry: Find, Details, Source, Individuals, Text Analysis, Add entity, Suggestions, Suggestion runs, Touchpoints, Sparsity, Ontology Quality, Tab History, Error log and the command palette. A View menu that lists all of them is correct, and unusable as the only pointer route to any of them. The rail carries the ten you move between, one click each, with a badge when a pane has something waiting, and scrolls rather than hiding one if the window is too short for all ten. View stays complete for the keyboard and the palette. Neither one is a worse version of the other.

Menu contents are unchanged

Grouping, counts, submenus and access keys come from docs/menu-ux.md. The Window menu is that document's list verbatim, Move pane submenu included. Show instances carries its count and would disable itself at zero, per the counts rule. Separators mark the groups, which is what that document recommends first and cascades second. Redo is rendered disabled and still focusable, as the W3C pattern requires.

MenuSource of its contents
WindowDocumented in full and reproduced verbatim
File, Edit, ViewDocumented item by item across the docs tree
GraphTop level documented. Layout and Pan and zoom are named as existing submenus but their items are not enumerated anywhere, so the items shown are a placeholder

Wiring it in Electron

titleBarStyleSet to hidden so the frame stops drawing its own caption
titleBarOverlayGive it color, symbolColor and height: 36. Windows then draws the three caption buttons itself, inside the band
Drag regionThe header is -webkit-app-region: drag. Every control inside it sets no-drag. Miss one and it stops responding to the pointer
Reserved width--w-wco is 138px, the Windows default for three buttons. Read env(titlebar-area-width) if you want the real figure at runtime
The glyphs herePlaceholders, drawn so the reservation is visible. Delete them: they are not yours to draw
ThemeUpdate titleBarOverlay through setTitleBarOverlay when the theme changes, or the caption buttons keep the old colour

What this supersedes, and what it does not

"The duplicate filename and command palette icon have been removed."

Superseded, narrowly. From docs/workbench-controls.md. There is still no duplicate filename: the pill is the only place the document is named. But the pill does open the palette from the chrome, which that sentence removed. The difference from what was taken out is that this is the document itself, not an icon sitting beside it.

"Windows retains the native minimize, maximize and close controls."

Not superseded. The overlay is drawn by Windows, so the controls stay native, keep their snap layouts flyout on hover, and keep their accessibility. This is the whole reason to use the overlay rather than draw three buttons.

"The Windows title bar shows Axiom | absolute path, with the filename in bold. An asterisk indicates unsaved changes."

Kept. The pill shows the filename in bold with its folder beside it and the asterisk when there are unsaved changes. The window title property should keep carrying the full string for the taskbar and for screen readers.

Two decisions worth not undoing

The status bar is one left aligned row. VS Code splits its status bar and pushes a group to the far right. At 2,867 pixels that puts a clickable item most of a screen away from the thing it describes, which is the defect this whole file is about. Every segment sits in reading order from the left, and the empty width after the last one is correct rather than unfinished.

A badge is a count capped at 999 plus. Ontology Quality has 6,844 findings. A 48 pixel rail cannot print that, and widening the rail to fit a number is the same mistake one scale down. A count of zero renders no badge at all, because a badge reading zero is a notification that nothing happened.

Thresholds

Three, each stated once, as container queries against the shell rectangle. docs/adaptive-pane-ux.md governs the ten dockable panes at 600 and 400, and does not reach window chrome, so these are this surface's own numbers rather than a contradiction of that policy.

WidthWhat changes
1100The pill drops the folder and keeps the filename
820The eight triggers fold into one button whose popup carries all eight menus
620The pill withdraws. The status bar sheds its counts and keeps save state
239Recovery. The rail, tabs and status bar withdraw and the band is the whole chrome

Keyboard

AltReveals the access key underlines and moves focus to File
Alt plus a letterOpens that menu directly
Left RightMoves between menus. Inside a submenu, Left closes it and returns focus to its parent
Up Down Home EndMoves through items. Disabled items take focus and do not run
A letterRuns the item carrying that access key
EscCloses the current level and returns focus to what opened it
TabLeaves the menu entirely rather than moving within it
Ctrl Shift POpens the command palette, which searches every leaf command in all eight menus

What is live here

All eight menus open and navigate. Theme and Workbench arrangement are real radio groups. Save clears the unsaved marker in the pill and the status bar, and Undo sets it again. The rail switches panes and drives the tab strip and the status bar. The palette searches the real menu model and runs what it finds. The sheet you are reading is a placeholder for the pane content, not a proposed view.
